purpose: Teach: 親しく/ノック/バレンタイン/小児科/丸ごと/ひととき/救っ/かなわ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと、もっと、親しくなろうね、いつも、仲良しよ。
lines.en: Sho, let's get even closer, okay? We're always friends.
lines.style: Soft, inviting tone. Slight pause after his name — letting it land. Gentle lean forward in her voice. Warm without pressure. A promise held gently in the trailing word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの家のドア、ぼく、ノックして、入ったよ、ちゃんと、できたよ。
lines.en: I knocked on your door and came in just right, didn't I?
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in the voice. No performance — just pleased with himself for doing it correctly. Slight lift at the end, seeking quiet confirmation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: バレンタインの日、メイ姉さん、翔くんに、プレゼント、用意してるからね。
lines.en: For Valentine's Day, I'm getting a gift ready for you, Sho.
lines.style: Warm certainty. No drama — just a simple statement of care. Gentle, almost matter-of-fact delivery. The affection is in the commitment, not the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの妹、看護師で、小児科で、働いているって、聞いたよ。
lines.en: I heard your sister — Mei's sister — she's a nurse in pediatrics, right?
lines.style: Bright curiosity, genuinely interested. Slight uncertainty in the middle — checking if he knows what he's talking about. Open, observant tone. Not testing, just wondering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祭りの夜、たこ焼き、丸ごと、ぱくっと、食べた、翔くん、楽しかったね。
lines.en: That night at the festival, you popped that whole takoyaki in your mouth — you had so much fun.
lines.style: Warm recall, almost tender amusement. A small smile in the voice. Gentle nostalgia without any condescension. The memory is hers and his together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、ひととき、お絵描き、する時間、ぼく、大好きなんだ。
lines.en: Those quiet times drawing with you — I love them so much.
lines.style: Soft, sincere admission. No hesitation. Slow enough to mean it. The kind of thing said when you're sure it's safe. Gentle fadeout at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 絵本のヒーロー、皆を救ったお話、感動的だね、翔くん、覚えてる?
lines.en: That picture book — the hero who saved everyone — that was so moving. Do you remember it?
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. A gentle question, not testing his memory but inviting him into the shared moment. Slight pause before the question, like reaching back together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんのお絵描きには、ぼく、かなわないよ、上手すぎるんだもん、本当に。
lines.en: Your drawing can't match mine, and you know it — yours are just too good already.
lines.style: Gentle, genuine awe at the end. Not self-deprecating — observing his talent with real wonder. Warm, no edge. The kind of thing said when you're safe enough to mean it plainly.
